## What's new

- **No more graphics use in the background.** On Windows, RayLink kept drawing its animations while it was minimized or closed to the tray. It now stops completely until you open the window again. The Mac version has the same fix for the menu bar.
- **Lighter while the window is open.** Animations now run at a steady 20 frames per second on every platform, and on Windows and macOS the still parts of Home are no longer redrawn for every frame. RayLink looks the same, and the graphics card has far less to do.
